title: Assault on doctors: Maharashtra Court grants bail to Shiv Sena corporator Ramesh Mhatre
description: A magistrate court in Maharashtra's Kalyan on Tuesday granted bail to Shiv Sena corporator Ramesh Mhatre arrested in connection with the assault on doctors and medical staff at a civic hospital in ThaneMhatre was remanded to judicial custody on July 13 after the expiry of his police custody. Soon thereafter, his lawyer moved for bail, which was heard and allowed today.During the hearing, the police opposed the plea by arguing that Mhatre’s release could endanger the complainant doctor and cited
